name: shopsphere
description: ShopSphere - an original, Amazon-inspired full-stack e-commerce portfolio project

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run generate && npm run build -w @shopsphere/api && npm run build -w @shopsphere/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run generate && npm run typecheck -w @shopsphere/api && npm run typecheck -w @shopsphere/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w @shopsphere/api && npm run test -w @shopsphere/web
